newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Dec 24.

text.p: -- Digi International Inc said late Monday it had adjusted fiscal 1996 earnings lower for accounting changes, and it forecast weaker first quarter profits of $0.23-$0.27 a share due to revenue shortfalls and delays in new product rollouts.
Digi shares closed unchanged at 12-3/4 Monday.
-- Apple Computer Inc will take a $300 million charge in its fiscal second quarter for the purchase of NeXT Software Inc, Apple's chief financial officer said Monday.
-- Westmoreland Coal Co said it filed a Chapter 11 bankruptcy petition after talks to restructure $160 million in retiree benefit obligations broke down.

-- Day Runner Inc said late Monday it expects lower second quarter sales, resulting in earnings per share of $0.63-$0.68, down from $0.75 last year. It blamed weak sales to Wal-Mart and inventory tightening by certain other large customers.

-- Computer Network Technology Corp said it expects a fourth quarter charge of $0.08 a share to write down its purchase of Brixton technology. It also expects full-year revenues of $95-$99 million, up from $78.8 million for 1995.
